spec_features.spec_quote: we allow up to 3 consecutive give-ups before early-stopping
spec_features.evidence: config.py:62 stop_after_consecutive_giveups: int = 3. rollout.py:122-129 detect_giveup(res.text) increments consecutive_giveups (reset to 0 otherwise); rollout.py:204-210 'if loop_cfg.stop_after_consecutive_giveups > 0 and consecutive_giveups >= loop_cfg.stop_after_consecutive_giveups: tr.stop_reason = "consecutive_giveups"; break'. The counter is compared and breaks the loop, ending the rollout. detect_giveup at harness.py:260 matches terminal phrases.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired end-to-end: detection -> counter -> threshold compare -> break. Honored as a real stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We *record* the give-up but keep going a little, because continued post-giveup behaviour is itself a strong spiral signal.
